name: relai-input-router
description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.321). RelAI Input Router: a large file (2000 tokens or more), a PDF over 5 pages or the large output of a reader command (cat, head, tail...) is read first by a helper model (claude-haiku-5-5 by default); Claude gets its notes with line numbers and a path to the full text. RelAI process files (docs/, PROMPT_ETAP_*, STATUS.md, PLAN.*, .claude/relai/), instruction files (CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, settings), secret files, small ranges, grep/ls/find, builds, tests, git and errors always reach Claude whole. A large MCP connector result (16 000 characters or more) loses its empty fields and short text cuts first; what is still over 8000 characters goes to the helper in chunks. Connectors that drive the app, the browser, sessions, terminals or mods (ccd_*, Claude_Browser, playwright, computer-use, terminal, visualize, scheduled-tasks, mcp-registry, mods) and RelAI's own are never touched. Text with a secret found by the RelAI secret scanner never goes to the helper. Asks once per RelAI project (row 'Mody oszczędzania' in docs/USTAWIENIA.md) and stays passive in a session with no person before that answer. Sleeps while the BenAI 'input-router' mod is on. The hand-off pane (/relai-input-router pane) shows a card per hand-off with tokens before and after, the helper's cost, its notes and the full result, and buttons for the next read whole and the file and connector switches; the command does the same: stats, full, off|on file, off|on connector, model <id>. Notes are remembered by path, time, size and the ask (~/.claude/relai/oszczednosci/input-router/), and every hand-off goes to the RelAI savings ledger.
